_meta.note: Representative subset; extensible to all 110 controls. Objectives are the Retrieval-port content injected as decision CRITERIA.
_meta.translation: Each control carries evidence_types; each objective carries a discovery_query. The discovery loop (defer_for_evidence) uses these to generate catalog-driven, objective-specific evidence requests (Gap-1 Translation layer).

3.1.1.title: Limit system access to authorized users, processes, and devices
3.1.1.control: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other information systems).

objectives.text: authorized users are identified
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the inventory or directory export identifying every authorized user.

objectives.text: processes acting on behalf of authorized users are identified
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the list of processes/service accounts acting on behalf of authorized users.

objectives.text: devices (and other systems) authorized to connect to the system are identified
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the device/asset inventory identifying devices and systems authorized to connect.

objectives.text: system access is limited to authorized users
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the IAM/access config demonstrating system access is limited to those authorized users.

objectives.text: system access is limited to processes acting on behalf of authorized users
objectives.discovery_query: Provide config showing access is limited to the authorized processes/service accounts.

objectives.text: system access is limited to authorized devices (including other systems)
objectives.discovery_query: Provide NAC/802.1X or equivalent config limiting access to authorized devices only.

evidence_types: screenshot of enforcement on the boundary

3.1.2.title: Limit access to permitted transactions and functions
3.1.2.control: Limit information system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

objectives.text: the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute are defined
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the matrix defining which transactions/functions each authorized role may execute.

objectives.text: system access is limited to the defined types of transactions and functions for authorized users
objectives.discovery_query: Provide RBAC/authorization config demonstrating users are limited to those defined functions.

evidence_types: screenshot showing a user limited to permitted functions

3.1.4.title: Separate the duties of individuals
3.1.4.control: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion.

objectives.text: the duties of individuals requiring separation are defined
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the documentation defining which duties require separation.

objectives.text: responsibilities for duties that require separation are assigned to separate individuals
objectives.discovery_query: Provide role assignments showing those duties are split across separate individuals.

objectives.text: access privileges that enable individuals to exercise the duties that require separation are granted to separate individuals
objectives.discovery_query: Provide access-privilege grants showing the enabling privileges are held by separate individuals.

evidence_types: role assignments showing conflicting duties split across individuals

3.1.5.title: Employ the principle of least privilege
3.1.5.control: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts.

objectives.text: privileged accounts are identified
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the inventory of privileged accounts.

objectives.text: access to privileged accounts is authorized in accordance with the principle of least privilege
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the authorization/approval records showing privileged access follows least privilege.

objectives.text: security functions are identified
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the inventory of security functions.

objectives.text: access to security functions is authorized in accordance with the principle of least privilege
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the authorization records showing access to security functions follows least privilege.

3.1.7.title: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions
3.1.7.control: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs.

objectives.text: privileged functions are defined
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the definition/list of privileged functions.

objectives.text: non-privileged users are defined
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the definition of non-privileged users (e.g., the relevant AD groups).

objectives.text: non-privileged users are prevented from executing privileged functions
objectives.discovery_query: Provide config demonstrating non-privileged users cannot execute privileged functions.

objectives.text: the execution of privileged functions is captured in audit logs
objectives.discovery_query: Provide an audit-log sample showing privileged-function execution is captured.

3.1.11.title: Terminate a user session after a defined condition
3.1.11.control: Terminate (automatically) a user session after a defined condition.

objectives.text: conditions requiring a user session to terminate are defined
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the policy defining the conditions that require a session to terminate.

objectives.text: a user session is automatically terminated after any of the defined conditions occur
objectives.discovery_query: Provide GPO/OS config (and a screenshot) showing sessions auto-terminate after those conditions.

evidence_types: screenshot of enforced timeout on a boundary asset

3.1.12.title: Monitor and control remote access sessions
3.1.12.control: Monitor and control remote access sessions.

objectives.text: remote access sessions are permitted
objectives.discovery_query: Confirm and document that remote access sessions are permitted (or prohibited).

objectives.text: the types of permitted remote access are identified
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the list identifying the permitted types of remote access.

objectives.text: remote access sessions are controlled
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the gateway/VPN config demonstrating remote sessions are controlled.

objectives.text: remote access sessions are monitored
objectives.discovery_query: Provide SIEM/monitoring evidence that remote sessions are logged and reviewed.

evidence_types: monitoring/SIEM evidence of remote-session logging + review

3.1.22.title: Control CUI posted or processed on publicly accessible systems
3.1.22.control: Control information posted or processed on publicly accessible information systems.

objectives.text: individuals authorized to post or process information on publicly accessible systems are identified
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the list of individuals authorized to post/process content on public systems.

objectives.text: procedures to ensure CUI is not posted or processed on publicly accessible systems are identified
objectives.discovery_query: Provide the procedure ensuring CUI is not posted/processed on publicly accessible systems.

objectives.text: a review process is in place prior to posting of any content to publicly accessible systems
objectives.discovery_query: Provide evidence of a pre-posting review process for public content.

objectives.text: content on publicly accessible systems is reviewed to ensure that it does not include CUI
objectives.discovery_query: Provide records of periodic review of public content for inadvertent CUI.

evidence_types: list of individuals authorized to post public content
procedure preventing CUI on public systems
evidence of periodic public-content review for CUI
